ai/DEMO-1.title: fix(price): subtract the discount in applyDiscount instead of adding it
ai/DEMO-1.description:
DEMO-1

Change: in src/price.js, applyDiscount returned price + price*percent/100, so applyDiscount(100, 10) gave 110. It now returns price - price*percent/100 (90). The outdated BUG comment was removed. One file, +1 -2 lines.

Review verdict: pass (1 round). The reviewer read the code against test.js: applyDiscount(100, 10) = 90, applyDiscount(80, 25) = 60; no other callers of the function.

Not verified: `sh test.sh` was NOT run. The Coding bot's session could not execute shell commands, and Pipeline has no tool to run them either. The result rests on code review only. Please run `sh test.sh` (or CI) before merging.
